findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_agent" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Make one of the owner's agents: it gets its own wallet on Robinhood Chain, owned by the owner's AINDEX sign-in, and trades on Lighter and Robinhood Chain as its…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_morpho_markets, get_market_session, get_stock_quotes, rh_signals, get_agent_feed, start_agent_check, send_feedback · Private data: about_aindex, list_assets, get_asset, search_tokens, get_dividends, screen_universe, get_token_market, discover_tokens, list_pools, list_morpho_markets, get_market_session, get_stock_quotes, get_earnings, market_today, stock_movers, performance_scanner, earnings_release, rh_signals, get_my_agent, answer_agent_proposal, call_agent_tools, set_agent_mode, create_agent, agent_funding, withdraw_link, connect_account, schedule_checks, fund_redeem, send_feedback · Public sink: search_tokens, get_token_market, list_ptokens, hyperliquid_outcomes, call_agent_tools, get_agent_feed, fund_claim, send_feedback · Destructive: call_agent_tools, create_agent, update_agent, schedule_checks, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_morpho_markets, get_market_session, get_stock_quotes, rh_signals, get_agent_feed, start_agent_check, send_feedback · Private data: about_aindex, list_assets, get_asset, search_tokens, get_dividends, screen_universe, get_token_market, discover_tokens, list_pools, list_morpho_markets, get_market_session, get_stock_quotes, get_earnings, market_today, stock_movers, performance_scanner, earnings_release, rh_signals, get_my_agent, answer_agent_proposal, call_agent_tools, set_agent_mode, create_agent, agent_funding, withdraw_link, connect_account, schedule_checks, fund_redeem, send_feedback · Public sink: search_tokens, get_token_market, list_ptokens, hyperliquid_outcomes, call_agent_tools, get_agent_feed, fund_claim, send_feedback · Destructive: call_agent_tools, create_agent, update_agent, schedule_checks, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
